svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two sets (one a hood). Each side: a 900 long bar of 30 x 30

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: x 2.5 tube, ends capped, on two standoffs 800 apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Standoffs: 30 x 30 tube 57 long, welded to the bar and to a 100 x

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 100 x 3 foot plate with four 7 mm holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: foot plates on the hood sides, centred 60 down from the top,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through-bolted (4 x M6 each) to the backing plates in the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sized to carry ballast weights: up to 40 kg a hood, hung two a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side, at a load factor of 2 (bending about 34 MPa in the bar).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Take the weights off before the hood is lifted and moved.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 20 kg weight hung mid-bar: no visible bend or play.
